'''''UFC Fight Night: Adesanya vs. Magomedov''''' (also known as '''''UFC Fight Night 295''''') is an upcoming mixed martial arts event produced by the [[Ultimate Fighting Championship]] that is scheduled to take place on December 5, 2026, at the [[ANB Arena|anb Arena]] in [[Riyadh]], Saudi Arabia.<ref name="Riyadh">{{Cite web|url=https://www.mmamania.com/latest-news/479374/report-israel-adesanya-vs-shara-bullet-targeted-for-ufc-saudi-arabia-main-event-on-dec-5|title=Report: Israel Adesanya vs. Shara Bullet targeted for UFC Saudi Arabia main event on Dec. 5|publisher=mmamania.com|author=Andrew Richardson|date=2026-10-15|access-date=2026-10-15}}</ref>

==Background==
The event will mark the promotion's third visit to Riyadh and first since [[UFC Fight Night: Adesanya vs. Imavov]] in February 2025.<ref name="Riyadh"/> The event was initially reported for November 28 before being moved to December 5 for undisclosed reasons.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.estadiodeportivo.com/ufc/tras-aleks-topuria-hecher-sosa-asegura-ufc-gran-fin-noviembre-espanol-20261007-548112.html|title=Tras Aleks Topuria, Hecher Sosa asegura en la UFC un gran fin de noviembre español|publisher=estadiodeportivo.com|author=Antonio José Medina|date=2026-10-07|access-date=2026-10-07}} {{in lang|es}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.abc.es/deportes/mma/hecher-sosa-peleara-abdul-hussein-noviembre-ufc-20261008093743-nt.html|title=Hecher Sosa peleará contra Abdul Hussein el 28 de noviembre en el UFC Arabia Saudí|publisher=abc.es|author=Álvaro Colmenero|date=2026-10-07|access-date=2026-10-07}} {{in lang|es}}</ref>

Despite concerns regarding the realization of this event due to the [[2026 Houthi attacks on Saudi airports|Houthi attacks on Saudi airports]], less than eight weeks before the event is scheduled to take place, UFC CEO [[Dana White]] assured the event will continue as scheduled.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://sports.yahoo.com/articles/dana-white-dismisses-rumors-ufc-043231933.html|title=Dana White dismisses rumors of UFC Saudi Arabia event being rescheduled amid tensions in the Middle East|publisher=sports.yahoo.com|author=Kshitiz Kumar Singh|date=2026-10-19|access-date=2026-10-24}}</ref>

A middleweight bout between former two-time [[UFC Middleweight Championship|UFC Middleweight Champion]] [[Israel Adesanya]] and [[Sharabutdin Magomedov]] is scheduled to headline the event.<ref name="Riyadh"/><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.si.com/fannation/mma/news/ufc-saudi-arabia-adds-banger-fight-support-israel-adesanya-main-event|title=UFC Saudi Arabia adds banger fight to support Israel Adesanya main event|publisher=si.com|author=Drew Beaupre|date=2026-10-22|access-date=2026-10-27}}</ref>

A five-round welterweight bout between former [[UFC Welterweight Championship]] challenger [[Ian Machado Garry]] and former [[List of Bellator champions#Welterweight World Championship|Bellator Welterweight World Champion]] [[Yaroslav Amosov]] is scheduled to serve as the co-main event.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://mmajunkie.usatoday.com/story/sports/ufc/2026/11/07/ufc-saudi-arabia-ian-machado-garry-yaroslav-amosov-five-rounds-welterweight/92138466007/|title=Ian Machado Garry vs. Yaroslav Amosov set for UFC Saudi Arabia co-headliner|publisher=mmajunkie.usatoday.com|author=Nolan King|date=2026-11-07|access-date=2026-11-08}}</ref> They were originally scheduled to compete at [[UFC 335]] one week later, but the bout was moved to this event for undisclosed reasons.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://mmasucka.com/news/ian-machado-garry-vs-yaroslav-amosov-reportedly-set-for-ufc-335/|title=Ian Machado Garry vs. Yaroslav Amosov reportedly set for UFC 335|publisher=mmasucka.com|author=Proma Chatterjee|date=2026-10-24|access-date=2026-11-07}}</ref>

A featherweight bout between former [[Legacy Fighting Alliance#LFA Featherweight Championship|LFA Featherweight Champion]] Gabriel Santos and undefeated prospect Luke Riley is scheduled for the event.<ref name="santosriley">{{Cite web|url=https://middleeasy.com/mma-news/luke-riley-gabriel-santos-december5-saudi-report/|title=Luke Riley–Gabriel Santos bout reported for December 5 in Saudi Arabia|publisher=middleeasy.com|author=Jake Blend|date=2026-11-19|access-date=2026-11-20}}</ref> The bout was originally scheduled for [[UFC 335]] one week later, but was moved to this event for undisclosed reasons.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://bloodyelbow.com/2026/11/19/paddy-pimbletts-14-0-teammate-luke-riley-reportedly-books-ufc-335-return/|title=Paddy Pimblett's 14-0 teammate Luke Riley reportedly books UFC 335 return|publisher=bloodyelbow.com|author=Harvey Leonard|date=2026-11-19|access-date=2026-11-20}}</ref>
